SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Puducherry. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory and dispatch it fitted â€” walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done â€” to the PIPDIC industrial estates at Mettupalayam, Sedarapet and Thirubuvanai and to sites across the union territory. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Container Office Manufacturer for Puducherry PIPDIC Units range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands â€” no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. Across the PIPDIC estates in Puducherry, that lets an auto or light-manufacturing unit add an admin office, a QC room or a site cabin without holding up the line.

Who buys a container office in Puducherry

Puducherry (Pondicherry) has a settled base of auto-component and light-manufacturing units across its PIPDIC estates. Most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Auto-component and light-manufacturing units needing an admin, QC or supervisor office
  • PIPDIC estate units needing a stores or documentation cabin
  • EPC and civil contractors needing a temporary site office for a project
  • Plots and yards needing a gate and security office at the entrance

Every unit we supply is an administrative or site cabin â€” a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as process, paint-shop or hazardous-area structures.

We supply container offices across the main PIPDIC pockets of Puducherry:

  • Mettupalayam PIPDIC Industrial Estate, Thattanchavady â€” 605009

These estates run on auto components, engineering and light manufacturing â€” buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working line. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Puducherry site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point â€” a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, QC or supervisor office â€” a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area â€” a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Puducherry is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat and handle the coastal humidity
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Puducherry sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Puducherry is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Krishnagiri and Tiruvannamalai into Puducherry â€” roughly 310â€“360 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3â€“5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is â‚¹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the northern Tamil Nadu belt? See container offices we take to Chennai, container offices we supply to the Sri City side, and container offices built at our Bangalore works.

Documentation for vendor onboarding

Auto and engineering units in Puducherry often supply into larger OEMs and need clean paperwork. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1â€“2 years on finishing, with a 20â€“25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Puducherry

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Puducherry. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote â€” no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Puducherry?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Puducherry site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to the Sedarapet and Mettupalayam PIPDIC estates?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Tiruvannamalai to the Mettupalayam estate (605009), Sedarapet (605111), Thirubuvanai (605107) and Puducherry city (605001) â€” about 310â€“360 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

A 20 ft cabin covers most admin, QC and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and e-way bill for vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.
